test_title: PYST 30: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 09 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following question below are given some statements followed by some conclusions based on those statements. Taking the given statements to be true even if they seem to be at variance from commonly known facts. Read all the conclusions and then decide which of the given conclusion logically follows the given statements.

**Statements:**

I. All A are M.

II. No M is B.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some M are A.

II. Some B are M.

III. Some A are B.

options.text: Both conclusions I and III follows
Both conclusions II and III follows

solution:
Statements:

I. All A are M.

II. No M is B.

The least possible diagram for the given statements is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2a4845507676edaaba564fb397f120d30b28115e5051ddb08966ec3a2dbe5cb7.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some M are A → True (It is given that all A are M, so some M are A)

II. Some B are M → False (No direct relationship given between B and M, so it may be possible but not defined)

III. Some A are B → False (No direct relationship given between A and B, so it may be possible but not defined)\

Hence,** "Only conclusion I follows"**.
